title: Global console project dashboard links fall back to global route
description: Evidence: apps/console/src/components/global/global-dashboard.tsx links to /repo?project=<id>, but apps/console/src/app/routes.ts defines /repo only for repo scope and falls back to the first global route in global scope; server routing ignores project selection. Impact: Open project dashboard does not open the selected repo dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Global project links either switch to a repo-scoped dashboard for the selected project or expose a disabled/accurate action, with route tests for global project selection.
